svg.text: Why Google Cloud Lakehouse outperforms legacy ETL and uncached federation
Eliminates batch copy lag and repeat cloud egress fees while preserving real-time governance across clouds

g.text: Double storage bill + stale supply chain data
Outcome: Too slow & brittle for live operations
Re-fetches identical Parquet files over WAN
Queries Unity, Glue, Snowflake & Workday in place
Hot Parquet blocks in us-east4 ($0 GCP fee)
Outcome: Local speed, live governance & predictable cost

svg.text: Fresh snapshot & ACL check on every read
